headline_outcome: Buy Your Warehouse. Build Your Future.
primary_text: "I want to own the property so when I retire I can lease it out as passive income." Here's the maths: buy a Truganina warehouse now, pay it off while you operate your business, and at retirement you own a commercial asset in one of Melbourne's busiest freight corridors. Industrial rents in the west have been climbing year on year. A paid-off warehouse could deliver $40,000+ annually in passive rental income — no stock to manage, no staff to pay, no early mornings. Just a tenant and a lease. Off-the-plan pricing means you start building equity from day one. Your retirement plan shouldn't rely on hope. Make it property.
